title: Zero-dimensional system dichotomy
statement: Let $L$ be a finite system of homogeneous quadratic equations in zero variables over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Either every zero-dimensional Boolean word satisfies every equation in $L$, or no zero-dimensional Boolean word satisfies every equation in $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite homogeneous quadratic system over $\mathbb{F}_2$ with zero variables
